div.head: Af 5.5
div.ab: Se ðe stalað on Sunnonniht oþþe on Geohhol oððe on Eastron oþþe on ðone halgan Ðunresdæg on Gongdagas: þara æghwylc we willaþ sy twybote, swa Lenctenfæsten.
Se ðe stalað on Sunnanniht oððe on Gehhol oððe on Eastron oððe on ðone halgan Þunresdæg on Gangdagas: ðara gehwelc we willað sie twybote, swa on Lenctenfæsten.
Se ðe stalað ón Sunnanniht oðð on Geol oððe on Eastron oððe on ðone halgan Þunresdæg ⁊ on Gangdagas: ðara gehwylc we willað, sy twybote, swa on Lenctenfæsten.
Qui furatur die dominica uel in sancto natali uel in pascha uel in sancto die Iouis in ascensione Domini: in quolibet eorum uolumus dupliciter emendandum sit, sicut in quadragesimali ieiunio.
Se ðe staleð on Sunnanniht oððe on Gehhol oððe on Eastron oððe on ðone halgan Ðunresdæg on Gangdagas: ðara gehwelc we willað sie twybote, swa on Lenctenfæsten.
He who steals on Sunday (night) or on Christmas or on Easter or on Holy Thursday [or] during Rogation Days: each of those [offenses] we wish to count two-fold, as in the Lenten fast.
We decree that he who steals on a Sunday, or during Christmas or Easter, or on Holy Thursday, at Rogation Days, shall pay in each case double compensation, just as he must [if he steals] during Lent.
Whoever steals on Sunday or at Christmas or Easter or on the Holy Thursday in Rogation days; each of those we wish to be compensated doubly, as in the Lenten fast.
Wer stiehlt am Sonntage oder zu Weihnachten oder zu Ostern oder am heiligen Donnerstag in den Betfahrtstagen: deren jeder stehe, wollen wir, in Doppelbusse, ebenso wie zu Frühlingsfasten.
Whoever steals on Sunday or at Christmas or at Easter or on Holy Thursday in Rogation Days: each of these, we wish, is to be subject to double compensation, just as in the Lenten fast.
